headline: Executive order creates a White House Council for Community Solutions.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up a council at the White House focused on community solutions. No summary was provided, so details such as who sits on the council, what it does, and how long it lasts cannot be confirmed here. Councils like this usually give advice rather than create new rules or spending.

who_it_affects.how: The order appears to create a new council that would work on community-focused issues, though its exact duties are not described in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 14, 2010; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
